summary: Carry the current canonical Karmic runtime into beta: DeepSeek-V4.1 Engram lookups finish before graph replay, and startup fetches tuning winners from the tuning rank
compatibility: No user action required. VLLM_DS41_ENGRAM_OVERLAP is removed and has no effect.
details: DeepSeek-V4.1 enqueues its disk Engram gathers on the current stream before the target graph replays. A side-stream lookup could be starved by graph polling kernels, time out and leave stale rows visible to the model.
At startup, ranks that did not compile a tuning winner fetch its compiled program from the rank that did, with digest validation and a fallback to compiling locally.
Profiling plans are released in one batch (canonical's version of vllm#941). The Spark RDMA launch scripts use four compiler workers.
